notes.built: 2026-10-10, read-only: Wikidata API (wbsearchentities, full-text search, wbgetentities) at no more than 1 request per second, and govdirectory.org (the United States page, its New York and North Carolina pages, and the agency pages of the items found there).
notes.scope: Bodies named as actors, lanes or step recipients in curated/<state>/<question>.json, as actors and office slots in curated_ask/*/*.json, in AskBench nuggets, and in the text of the gold sections and model sections (fixtures/statutes/*_sections.json and the search index). A few appeal and filing bodies named in curated/places/* are included. Incidental mentions (funds, unrelated agencies in definitions lists, out-of-state bodies) were left out.
notes.match: exact: the Wikidata item is the body the text names, or the agency the named officer heads (e.g. 'the Tax Commissioner' -> Virginia Department of Taxation). parent body only: no item for the body; qid is the body it sits inside. none: no item found. A generic role ('the board', 'the clerk of the court', 'a court', 'the sheriff') has generic_role true and resolves only through context (the profession, the county, the case); class_qid points to a system or class item where Wikidata has one.
notes.resolved_name: The body the text refers to, resolved through the statute's context; null for a generic role that context does not settle. qid_label is the Wikidata label, which can lag a renaming (California Prison Industry Authority).
notes.contacts: website, email and phone are P856, P968 and P1329 of the qid item only; contact_scope says whether they belong to the body itself (item) or to its parent (parent). units lists sub-units (usually registration-authority items for business filing) that carry their own channels. Only organisational channels are recorded: agency websites and office mailboxes. No contact details of individuals were collected, including those that appear in the places models.
notes.govdirectory: true when the body's own item (match exact) is listed on govdirectory.org; for a parent-body match the body itself is not listed and govdirectory_parent says whether the parent is. Gov Directory is built from Wikidata and, for the United States, covers federal bodies plus only New York and North Carolina state bodies, so every California, DC, Florida, Illinois, Maryland, Ohio, Texas, Virginia and Washington body is false. false is also used for a specific body without a Wikidata item (it cannot be listed); null for a generic role with no item.
notes.position_items: For several officers (Illinois and Texas Secretary of State, Texas, DC and Maryland Attorney General, US Attorney for DC) Wikidata has only a position item, not an item for the office as an organisation; item_kind marks these. Where both exist, qid is the agency item and related_items holds the position.
notes.caveats: Item Q7707525 (Texas Attorney General) carries a wrong English description (it says the office heads the Texas Department of Criminal Justice). Q131572971 (New York Coalition for Open Government) is an NGO and must not be matched to the Committee on Open Government. Q5283412 (DC Department of Consumer and Regulatory Affairs) is dissolved (2022) but is still the item tagged as DC's registration authority.
